snippet.title: Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Deathmaster | Reveal Teaser
snippet.description:
Wishlist Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Deathmaster now-now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3756700/Warhammer_Age_of_Sigmar_Deathmaster/

Play a sneaky & brutal Skaven Assassin in this new, refreshing but gritty take on the 2D Action platformer genre. Coming 2027 on PC, PS5, Xbox Series X|S & Nintendo Switch 2.

Escape, Kill, Ascend and Become a Deathmaster.

Wishlist now-now also on:
- GOG: https://www.gog.com/game/warhammer_age_of_sigmar_deathmaster
- PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10019271
- Xbox: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9pbg1p9q0ltg

For more Warhammer Age of Sigmar: Deathmaster updates, join us on social media:
X / Twitter: https://x.com/DeathmasterGame
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/gaming/dotemu
